evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 7.3 ppm, consistent with the approximately 5–7 ppm post-purge ramp baseline.
Oxygen rose to 12.0 ppm at growth onset.
Oxygen continued rising to 29.2 ppm despite stable argon flow.
Oxygen reached 44.7 ppm after increasing at every growth observation, indicating loss of the established low-oxygen condition.
Temperature 750.3 °C and argon 99.9 sccm track setpoints of 750 °C and 100 sccm; controller reports running.
No pressure gauge is installed; null pressure readings are not a sensor fault and cannot distinguish leakage from exhaust problems.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification, leak testing, and exhaust patency/pressure checks are needed to distinguish air ingress, exhaust restriction, outgassing, or oxygen-sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
